items.heading: Tulsi plant near the house
details: Tulsi (holy basil) is a natural air purifier that releases oxygen for long hours and repels mosquitoes.
Its leaves carry well-documented medicinal and immunity-boosting properties, used in home remedies for coughs and colds.

items.heading: Neem tree near the house
details: Provides shade and biodiversity, and contains compounds useful for natural insect control around the home.

items.heading: Tulsi Kota / Brindavan
details: A dedicated household plant-growing space that encourages cultivation of Tulsi and other useful plants.

items.heading: Traditional kitchen gardens
details: Provide fresh herbs and vegetables at hand and help preserve local plant varieties across generations.
